title: Terraform and Kubernetes
summary: Provision a local kind cluster with Terraform, configure the kubernetes and helm providers from cluster outputs (including helm provider v3 syntax), deploy namespaces, workloads, Gateway API CRDs and Helm releases, avoid the two-phase apply trap, and draw the line between Terraform and GitOps. Ends with an EKS overview.
objectives: Create and destroy a kind cluster with the `tehcyx/kind` provider and expose its credentials as outputs
Configure the `kubernetes` and `helm` providers from another stack's outputs instead of a hard-coded kubeconfig
Write helm provider v3 syntax (`kubernetes = { ... }`, `set = [ ... ]`) and recognise v2-style blocks in old examples
Manage namespaces and deployments with `*_v1` resources and arbitrary objects with `kubernetes_manifest`
Explain the two-phase problem and split cluster, platform and workload stacks accordingly
Decide what belongs in Terraform (cluster, platform add-ons) and what belongs in a GitOps tool like Argo CD (applications)
Read an EKS configuration built with `terraform-aws-modules/eks` and estimate what it costs
